illustration_style: Cosy seasonal colouring-book line art with original storybook charm, using playful rounded forms and inviting domestic-scale detail.
line_weight: Bold black outer contours with medium-weight interior detail lines; maintain generous enclosed colouring areas.
line_quality: Smooth, gently imperfect hand-inked curves with softened corners and clear, steady joins.
detail_level: Medium detail: clear focal silhouettes supported by selectively simplified decorative texture; avoid tiny marks and overly intricate repeats.
character_language: Friendly, softly stylised cartoon characters with rounded proportions, simple expressive faces, and readable clothing or feature shapes.
background_density: Moderately full scenic backgrounds built in shallow layers, with enough open space inside forms for relaxed colouring.
composition: Use one immediately readable focal area per page, balanced supporting details, varied page rhythms, and clear visual separation between overlapping forms.
palette: Monochrome black ink on white paper; designs should suggest a warm autumn atmosphere through motif and linework rather than filled colour.
shading: No solid shading or grey fills; use sparse contour accents, simple texture lines, and occasional small pattern details only.
texture: Light hand-drawn texture through wood grain, leaf veins, fabric seams, masonry marks, and natural surface accents, always kept broad and colourable.
mood: Warm, peaceful, whimsical and gently festive, with an unhurried cosy feel.
print_considerations: A4 and US Letter friendly portrait pages with clean white backgrounds, no full-bleed ink areas, strong line contrast, and details large enough to reproduce clearly on typical home printers.
shared_prompt: Original cosy autumn colouring-book line art in clean black ink on white paper; bold rounded outer contours, smooth subtly hand-drawn linework, medium-weight interior details, broad colourable enclosed shapes, friendly softly stylised cartoon expressions, sparse natural and handmade texture marks, no filled shading, calm storybook warmth and home-printer-friendly clarity.
avoid: Any wording, typography, byline, badge device, character design, asset, or scene arrangement from the supplied references
Inflated outlined title lettering or circular lower-corner count callouts resembling the references
Photorealism, painterly colour fills, grey wash, heavy black backgrounds, or ink-heavy solid areas
Overcrowded pages, micro-details, tangled overlaps, or narrow uncolourable gaps
Frightening imagery, harsh horror styling, or menacing facial expressions
Misspelled text, illegible lettering, logos, trademarks, or artist signatures
